_comment: Advisories that `npm audit` reports but which are not reachable in this
application. Every entry must carry a justification and an expiry date.
This is NOT a way to defer work on an exploitable finding. An entry is only
legitimate when the vulnerable code path cannot be reached at all. If a fix
exists and is installable, bump the dependency instead.
Entries are checked by .github/scripts/audit-check.mjs. An expired entry is a
hard failure, so every suppression comes back for review on its own.
`workspaces` names the directory an entry was justified for. This repo has
one lockfile, at the root, so it is always ["."].

allow.reason: deepmerge-ts 7.1.5 reaches the tree only through @prisma/config, which the Prisma CLI uses to merge its own configuration. The API never loads it, and the CLI merges this repository's prisma.config.ts, not anything a user sends, so a recursive object graph cannot reach it. No fix is installable: every Prisma 7 release pins 7.1.5 exactly and the patched line starts at 8.0.0. Remove when Prisma ships a patched deepmerge-ts.

braces 3.0.3 reaches the tree only through eslint-config-next (fast-glob, micromatch), a development dependency of the linter. It is not in the image, and the glob patterns it expands come from the lint configuration in this repository, never from a request. No patched release exists: the advisory covers every published version, up to the latest, 3.0.3. Remove when a patched braces is released.
